binding_rules.unknown_representation: null with explicit UNBOUND status; never substitute zero as verified data
binding_rules.test_fixture: Explicit simulation-only profile; must not establish production binding validity
binding_rules.configuration_update: Validate inactive profile then commit atomically at safe boundary; retain referenced versions or drain users
binding_rules.gain_order: Use validated actual gain ordering; logical HIGH/MID/LOW labels alone do not prove physical ordering
binding_rules.units: Every numeric calibration and timing field must carry defined units and fixed-point format in its implementation schema
binding_rules.core_io: Logical requests and normalized feedback; polarity and control encoding belong to a board adapter
binding_rules.pin_binding: Package pins belong to board constraints; software register writes cannot dynamically remap FPGA package pins
binding_rules.hardware_evidence: Binding validation does not substitute for physical fail-safe or RF measurement evidence
